name: May Ziadeh
shortBio: Lebanese-Palestinian philosopher, essayist, and convener of Cairo’s premier Nahda literary-philosophical salon who articulated cosmopolitan Arab humanism and wrote foundational feminist biographies of Aisha al-Taymuriyya and Malak Hifni Nasif.
centralQuestion: How can cross-cultural philosophical dialogue and women’s intellectual salons forge an egalitarian Arab modernity?

keyWorks.title: Bahithat al-Badiya: Dirasat Naqdiyya (Critical Study of Malak Hifni Nasif)
keyWorks.description: Philosophical assessment of Nasif’s feminist social ethics and the intellectual genealogy of early Arab women thinkers.

keyWorks.title: Equality (Al-Musawat)
keyWorks.description: Comparative treatise analyzing class hierarchy, aristocracy, socialism, and moral equality across East and West.
